label: Working on
body: A second identity system for Northbound, this time for their winter range, and a small type-only site for a friend's record label.

label: Reading
body: Rereading Bringhurst on the train, slowly. Also a stack of old Danish design annuals I found in a shop on Værnedamsvej.

label: Thinking about
body: Whether the case study is a useful format any more, or whether it just launders the mess of a project into a straight line.

label: Availability
body: One project open from March. Say hello if the timing is close — I would rather hear early than perfectly.
